text:
miko: Quick sync on Dataset Import modal: two related questions — where do hints live vs inline errors, and what's our pattern for deleting items (typed-confirm vs undo)? jamal: Leaning: persistent helper text under labels for examples/limits; inline errors only after a validation event (blur or submit). Avoid flashing errors while typing. sara: Accessibility: asterisk alone isn't enough. Use visible marker + aria-required="true" and aria-describedby pointing to helper text so SR users get the hint. laura: Example:
Accepted: CSV or JSON
. Also keep helper text short in narrow modals. ethan: For errors: show non-blocking format hints on blur, blocking errors after submit. Use a small fade animation so it isn't jarring. miko: Good. Copy rule: error text = terse action ("Enter a valid email"), helper text = why/where used. laura: Delete flows: typed-confirm for high-risk, irreversible dataset deletes. For row-level deletes use modal confirm + undo toast. sara: Let's add a risk-tier mapping to patterns doc: low = inline confirm + undo; medium = modal confirm with a checkbox; high = typed-confirm. ethan: Edge case: regulatory irreversible deletes should always be high-risk. Backend needs a flag (sensitiveDeletion) to force typed-confirm on UI. miko: Action items: jamal/laura update Figma with aria-describedby examples; ethan add sensitiveDeletion to API; sara draft risk-tier bullets; miko consolidate microcopy examples. design-bot: Figma frame: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/import-modal-v4 — review and comment. jamal: I'll prototype the undo toast for row delete and post screenshots. laura: I'll add focus trap + not auto-focusing confirm button to modal component notes. miko: Thanks — I'll fold changes into the validation patterns doc after PRs land. :thumbsup:
